name: Fractal Geometry (Recharge 5–6)
description: Esix unleashes recursive psychic energy. Each creature of Esix’s choice within 30 feet must make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage and is Dazed until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and is not Dazed.
